$comment: Source of truth for tools exposed by the Seiva MCP server. The canonical IDE entrypoint is seiva-mcp/client.js (referenced by .mcp.json); seiva-mcp/index.js is kept as a partnership-admin alternate entrypoint and exposes the same callable tools. Loaded by Seiva.Test.McpToolsCatalog as the coverage gate. Each entry: name, method (HTTP verb or null), path (mgmt path with :param placeholders, or null), description, category, client_only (true if no HTTP call — checkout/state tools run locally and bypass the coverage gate).

tools.name: seiva_list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces accessible by this API key.

tools.name: seiva_select_workspace
tools.description: Select which workspace to operate on (client-side state).

tools.name: seiva_create_workspace
tools.description: Create a new workspace inside the partnership of this API key.

tools.name: seiva_list_apps
tools.description: List all apps in the workspace.

tools.name: seiva_get_app
tools.description: Get details of a specific app.

tools.name: seiva_get_context
tools.description: Returns FULL builder context for an app.

tools.name: seiva_get_project_context
tools.description: Get structured project context (summary, manifest, palette).

tools.name: seiva_list_instructions
tools.description: List all available instruction/prompt files.

tools.name: seiva_get_instructions
tools.description: Load content of specific instruction files by name.

tools.name: seiva_list_files
tools.description: List all files in an app.

tools.name: seiva_read_file
tools.description: Read a specific file by path.

tools.name: seiva_write_file
tools.description: Create or update a single file.

tools.name: seiva_edit_file_diff
tools.description: Apply surgical edits to an existing file using search-and-replace diffs.

tools.name: seiva_write_files
tools.description: Create or update multiple files at once (batch).

tools.name: seiva_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file by path.

tools.name: seiva_set_app_permissions
tools.description: Update an app's permissioning (visibility, allowed_user_ids, sharing_mode, allowed_agent_ids).

tools.name: seiva_build_app
tools.description: Compile and deploy an app.

tools.name: seiva_create_app
tools.description: Create a new workspace app (auto-scaffolds React+Tailwind starter). Requires a user-scoped API key.

tools.name: seiva_publish_app
tools.description: Snapshot the app's working tree as a published version.

tools.name: seiva_get_app_runtime_errors
tools.description: List runtime errors captured by the app SDK (window.onerror, unhandledrejection, console.error).

tools.name: seiva_list_app_agents
tools.description: List agents available to the app (for ai.ask() in app code).

tools.name: seiva_list_available_datapacks
tools.description: List Data Models and Analytics tables activated in the workspace, with current grants for this app.

tools.name: seiva_describe_datapack_table
tools.description: Describe a specific Data Model / Analytics table: columns, types, sample rows.

tools.name: seiva_request_datapack_grant
tools.description: Request workspace-admin approval (HITL) to grant the app access to specific tables.

tools.name: seiva_request_external_dependency
tools.description: Classify/approve an external host for CSP script-src or connect-src.

tools.name: seiva_upload_app_asset
tools.description: Upload an asset (image, font, PDF, JSON) into the app's storage via Management API.

tools.name: seiva_list_pending_approvals
tools.description: List HITL approvals still pending (datapack grants, external-dep requests).

tools.name: seiva_acquire_app_lock
tools.description: Acquire the EditLock on an app for the current user (user-scoped key required).

tools.name: seiva_renew_app_lock
tools.description: Renew the EditLock TTL; auto re-acquires if expired between heartbeats.

tools.name: seiva_release_app_lock
tools.description: Release the EditLock held by the current user.

tools.name: seiva_get_app_lock
tools.description: Inspect the current EditLock state (free or held + holder info).

tools.name: seiva_list_app_data_grants
tools.description: List per-table data grants for an app (DataPacks + DuckLake).

tools.name: seiva_grant_app_data
tools.description: Grant or update an app's read/write access to a table in a DataPack or DuckLake view.

tools.name: seiva_revoke_app_data
tools.description: Revoke an app's access to a specific table.

tools.name: seiva_list_agents
tools.description: List all agents in the workspace.

tools.name: seiva_get_agent
tools.description: Get agent details by id.

tools.name: seiva_create_agent
tools.description: Create a new agent.

tools.name: seiva_update_agent
tools.description: Update an existing agent.

tools.name: seiva_delete_agent
tools.description: Delete (archive) an agent.

tools.name: seiva_list_skills
tools.description: List all skills in the workspace.

tools.name: seiva_get_skill
tools.description: Get skill details by id.

tools.name: seiva_create_skill
tools.description: Create a new skill.

tools.name: seiva_update_skill
tools.description: Update an existing skill.

tools.name: seiva_delete_skill
tools.description: Delete (archive) a skill.

tools.name: seiva_list_tools
tools.description: List all tools in the workspace.

tools.name: seiva_get_tool
tools.description: Get tool details including code_body.

tools.name: seiva_create_tool
tools.description: Create a new custom tool.

tools.name: seiva_update_tool
tools.description: Update an existing tool.

tools.name: seiva_delete_tool
tools.description: Delete a tool.

tools.name: seiva_list_builtin_tools
tools.description: List built-in tools available to this workspace.

tools.name: seiva_enable_builtin_tool
tools.description: Enable a built-in tool for the current workspace.

tools.name: seiva_list_schedules
tools.description: List all schedules in the workspace.

tools.name: seiva_get_schedule
tools.description: Get scheduled trigger details by id.

tools.name: seiva_create_schedule
tools.description: Create a new scheduled trigger.

tools.name: seiva_update_schedule
tools.description: Update an existing schedule.

tools.name: seiva_delete_schedule
tools.description: Delete a scheduled trigger.

tools.name: seiva_fire_schedule
tools.description: Fire a schedule immediately (async).

tools.name: seiva_pause_schedule
tools.description: Pause an active schedule.

tools.name: seiva_resume_schedule
tools.description: Resume a paused schedule.

tools.name: seiva_schedule_stats
tools.description: Get schedule statistics for the workspace.

tools.name: seiva_list_members
tools.description: List users in the workspace with their role.

tools.name: seiva_set_member_role
tools.description: Change a workspace member's role (owner/admin/member/viewer).

tools.name: seiva_get_logs
tools.description: List agent sessions with error counts.

tools.name: seiva_get_session_logs
tools.description: Get detailed logs for a specific agent session.

tools.name: seiva_get_build_logs
tools.description: Get build logs for an app.

tools.name: seiva_get_app_usage
tools.description: Get app usage logs.

tools.name: seiva_analyze_external_project
tools.description: Analyze an external project directory: framework, deps, backend SDKs, env vars, assets. Local filesystem only — no upload.

tools.name: seiva_generate_migration_plan
tools.description: Render a markdown migration plan from an analysis (or fresh source_path).

tools.name: seiva_import_project_files
tools.description: Batch-import a local project tree into a Seiva app — text files via /files/batch, binaries via /storage/files. Aborts on security-audit rejection.

tools.name: seiva_import_env_vars
tools.description: Persist .env entries as workspace credentials (encrypted). Replaces process.env.X with seiva.credential('X').

tools.name: seiva_list_credentials
tools.description: List workspace credentials (id, name, type, visibility — values never returned).

tools.name: seiva_create_credential
tools.description: Create a workspace credential with an encrypted value.

tools.name: seiva_app_checkout_status
tools.description: Inspect a Seiva App checkout in the cwd. Returns app_id, workspace_id, and added/modified/deleted files vs the last sync. Reads .seiva/manifest.json locally; no backend call.

tools.name: seiva_app_pull
tools.description: Pull the latest working tree from Seiva into the local checkout. Wraps the seiva CLI.

tools.name: seiva_app_push
tools.description: Push the local working tree to Seiva. Acquires EditLock and uses optimistic concurrency (expected_sha256 per file). Wraps the seiva CLI.

tools.name: seiva_app_build_local
tools.description: Build the app referenced by the local checkout, returning the preview URL. Wraps the seiva CLI (does not push first).

tools.name: seiva_tool_checkout_status
tools.description: Inspect a Seiva Tool checkout in the cwd. Returns tool_id, workspace_id, and which of (main.py, tool.json, input_schema.json) were locally modified. No side effects.

tools.name: seiva_tool_pull
tools.description: Pull the latest Python tool from Seiva into the local checkout. Wraps the seiva CLI.

tools.name: seiva_tool_push
tools.description: Push the local tool checkout to Seiva with EditLock + optimistic concurrency. Wraps the seiva CLI.
